d: Black Friday is here, and shoppers across the United States are turning to artificial intelligence to find the best bargains. But scammers are using the same technology to create convincing copies of legitimate online stores. These fake websites can replicate brand logos, product images and descriptions, making them difficult to distinguish from the real thing. More concerning, research cited by CBS News found that over 18 per cent of certain AI shopping and search responses drew on fake, infringing or invalid websites. Could your AI shopping assistant be sending you into a scam?…
